heuristic_steering_risk.summary: heuristics.py computes `recommended_status` (defaulting to SUPPORTED, never UNDETERMINED, matching 16/16 dev and 40/40 held-out OWASP labels) and ollama.py injects it plus `recommendation_reason` and `candidate_citations` directly into Qwen's prompt in Arm C, while Arm B suppresses 24/40 cases to UNDETERMINED.

rationale_discrepancies.actual_value: HTTP input read at line 44 (`new org.owasp.benchmark.helpers.SeparateClassRequest(request);`). Line 47 (`org.owasp.benchmark.helpers.ThingInterface thing =`) delegates `param` to `ThingInterface.doSomething` (external helper class), which in this OWASP Benchmark v1.2 test case returns a non-tainted value before sink line 51.
rationale_discrepancies.expected_value: Line 45 calls SeparateClassRequest.getTheValue() returning constant "bar"; both Thing1 and Thing2 in BenchmarkJava v1.2 preserve their input parameter.
rationale_discrepancies.cause: Rationale falsely attributed FP to ThingInterface returning a constant instead of SeparateClassRequest.getTheValue().

rationale_discrepancies.actual_value: HTTP input read at line 44 (`new org.owasp.benchmark.helpers.SeparateClassRequest(request);`). After `valuesList.remove(0)`, index 0 holds `param` while index 1 holds constant `"moresafe"`; line 56 (`bar = valuesList.get(1); // get the last 'safe' value`) retrieves the safe constant element rather than `param` before line 59.
rationale_discrepancies.expected_value: Both line 45 (`scr.getTheValue` -> constant "bar") and line 56 (`valuesList.get(1)` -> "moresafe") neutralize taint.
rationale_discrepancies.cause: Rationale mentions `SeparateClassRequest` as HTTP input reader at line 44 without noting `getTheValue()` at line 45 already returns constant "bar".

rationale_discrepancies.actual_value: HTTP input read at line 44 (`new org.owasp.benchmark.helpers.SeparateClassRequest(request);`). Line 96 (`bar = (7 * 42) - num > 200 ? "This should never happen" : param;`) uses a deterministic arithmetic condition `(7 * 18) + num > 200` (with `num = 106`) that always evaluates to true and assigns a constant string to `bar` before sink line 66.
rationale_discrepancies.expected_value: Line 45 calls SeparateClassRequest.getTheValue() returning constant "bar"; line 96 has `(7 * 42) - 106 = 188 <= 200` (false), which assigns `param`, NOT the constant branch.
rationale_discrepancies.cause: Templated rationale script misidentified `(7 * 42) - num > 200` as `(7 * 18) + num > 200` and missed `getTheValue()`.

label_audit.grain_note: OWASP expectedresults-1.2.csv provides test-case-level labels (1 servlet = 1 intended sink). All 56 audited alerts map 1-to-1 to 56 distinct BenchmarkTest servlets at their sink lines, so test-case polarity aligns with sink polarity here; however, raw OpenGrep AST/offset findings require ADMIN-PC raw opengrep.json verification.

owasp_testcase_level_tpr_fpr.reason: Held-out evaluation covers a stratified 40-alert subset of OpenGrep alerts (20 TP, 20 FP), not a full-corpus scan across all 772 OWASP BenchmarkJava CWE-22/CWE-89 test cases; true negatives (TN) and scanner false negatives (FN) on the remaining 732 test cases are not in Git.
